title: MemoryError while refreshing the overview (table.render)
body:
## Environment

Lattice 3.1.3, macOS 15.3, server ca-central-1.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
- Start by refreshing the overview.
- Run the same input in a loop for several hours.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

Expected refreshing the overview to finish without errors.

## Actual

Each run of the same input leaves memory a bit higher until
it fails. A fresh start handles the same input fine; after
hours of repeats it fails.

## Frequency

It occurs on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:211 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:63 in tiles
lattice/ui/table.py:70 in render
MemoryError: unable to allocate 2.0 GiB for row cache
